notes.title: Eros Fantasy 2.0 update
notes.notes:
[b]🚀 Eros Fantasy 2.0: Our Biggest Update Yet! 🚀[/b]

The [b]Eros Fantasy 2.0[/b] update is finally live, bringing [b]New Dates, Affection Mode, New Challenges,[/b] and much more! 🌟

[b]🖼️ Content Highlights:[/b]  
[list]
[*][b]26 Dates & H-Scenes[/b]  
[*][b]60 Underwear/Nude Portraits[/b]  
[*][b]2 Cinematic H-Scenes[/b]
[/list]

---

[b]❤️ New Affection System[/b]  
[list]
[*][b]Bio Info for All Girls:[/b] Explore detailed bios for your favorite characters.  
[*][b]Gifts & Affection Levels:[/b] Send gifts to boost affection, uncover secret likes/dislikes, and unlock:  
[list]
[*]Dates  
[*]Underwear & Nude Portraits  
[*]H-Scenes  
[*]Cinematic H-Scenes  
[/list]
[/list]

[list]
[*]Xenia, Liliana, Eleonora, Rachel, Oleen, Oana, Carolina, Xiu-Ying, Mei-Feng, Olivia, Emy, and Chun-Ling.  
[/list]

[b]Brand-New Dates:[/b] Meet these girls in exciting new stories!  
[list]
[*]Alexandra, Ivy, Audrey, Lisa, Shannon, Chelsea, Roselyn, Isabella, Lixue-Lang, Ivonne, Gabriela, Daphne, Rebecca, and Valeria.  
[/list]

[i](More characters and dates coming soon!)[/i]

[*][b]Shard's Challenge[/b] 🐉: Fight Dragonards for Orbs & Wildshards (Common, Rare, and Epic).

We hope you enjoy [b]Eros Fantasy 2.0[/b] and all the exciting new content featuring your favorite girls! Don’t forget to try out the new [b]Challenges[/b]! 🌸
